mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here, because today, we're setting out on a journey that feels more important than ever. Have you ever felt overwhelmed by all the information—sometimes conflicting, often confusing—that comes at us from every direction? Honestly, it’s easy to get lost in the noise, especially when misinformation seems to spread faster than the truth. That’s exactly why we’re diving into Pro Truth: A Practical Plan for Putting Truth Back into the Public Conversation, a thought-provoking guide by Stephen A. Reger. Together, we’ll explore the real challenges of sifting through fact and opinion, the subtle ways our own biases can trip us up, and why so many of us are left wondering who—or what—to trust. But here’s where it gets exciting. This isn’t just about pointing out the problems. We’ll walk through practical, everyday strategies for bringing honesty, evidence, and integrity back into our conversations—whether that’s online, at work, or around the dinner table. We’ll look closely at how we can hold ourselves and each other accountable, build real transparency, and sharpen our critical thinking skills. Imagine what we could accomplish if truth became our north star—not just as individuals, but as communities and institutions, all working to rebuild trust and make progress together. So, let’s get ready to challenge old habits and open up new ways of thinking. By the end of our time together, you’ll have a clear roadmap to help put truth at the center of your everyday life—and maybe even inspire others to do the same. Let’s explore how we can reclaim truth, one conversation at a time.
